_NOTE: TA and tutor names are deliberately NOT stored here - they must not appear anywhere on the public site, including the page source.
The Canvas pull still works and is kept for future use: run  npm run fetch-canvas  to repopulate 'tas' and 'tutors' from Canvas (needs a Canvas API token; see README 'Canvas Integration').

WARNING: that fetch, and 'npm run build' (which calls it), will write names back into this file, and anything in this file ships inside the website's JavaScript even when it is not displayed. Clear them again before publishing unless you want them public.
To display the sections once names are present, set SHOW_TEACHING_ASSISTANTS / SHOW_UNDERGRADUATE_ASSISTANTS to true in src/pages/TeachingStaff.tsx.
